def solve(di):
    import json
    H=len(di); W=len(di[0])
    # find objects (non-zero components, 4-connectivity)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
    for h in range(H):
        for w in range(W):
            if di[h][w]!=0 and not seen[h][w]:
                col=di[h][w]; st=[(h,w)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y][x]: continue
                    seen[y][x]=True; cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and di[ny][nx]==col and not seen[ny][nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                objs.append((col,min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs),cells))
    # divider row (all 5s)
    div=[h for h in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in di[h])]
    assert len(div)==1
    dh=div[0]
    top_objs=[o for o in objs if o[1]<dh]; bot_objs=[o for o in objs if o[1]>dh]
    assert len(bot_objs)==1
    b=bot_objs[0]; bc=b[2]
    # unique top color !=1, !=2
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(o[0] for o in top_objs)
    uniq=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==1]
    assert len(uniq)==1, (cnt,)
    u=uniq[0]
    au=[o for o in top_objs if o[0]==u]
    assert len(au)==1
    a=au[0]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(9)]
    # bottom object: shift up so its top row = 5 (preserve rel?) pair1: bot top row 11->5 (shift -6); pair2: 9->3 (shift -6)
    sh=b[1]-5
    for y,x in b[5]: out[y-sh][x]=b[0]
    # top object stacked directly above, aligned to bottom object columns
    for y,x in a[5]: out[y-(a[1]+sh)][x-a[2]+bc[2]]=a[0]
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(di):
    H=len(di); W=len(di[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
    for h in range(H):
        for w in range(W):
            if di[h][w]!=0 and not seen[h][w]:
                col=di[h][w]; st=[(h,w)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if seen[y][x]: continue
                    seen[y][x]=True; cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and di[ny][nx]==col and not seen[ny][nx]: st.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                objs.append((col,min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs),cells))
    div=[h for h in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in di[h])][0]
    bot=[o for o in objs if o[1]>div][0]
    top=[o for o in objs if o[1]<div]
    # delete color-2 objects and top color-1 objects; keep bottom (even if color 1)
    kept=[o for o in top if o[0]!=1 and o[0]!=2]
    kept.sort(key=lambda o:-o[1])  # taller/lower first? test: one object here
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(9)]
    btop=min(o[1] for o in [bot])+ (bot[4]-bot[3]+1)
    for y,x in bot[5]: out[y-(div-b[1]) if False else 0][x]=bot[0]
    # place bottom object starting at row = (input rows above divider) adjusted: pair1: bottom rows 11-13 -> out rows 5-7; shift = -(div+? ). bottom min row 11, out min row 5 => shift -6 = -(H//2+?) H=15: 11-6=5. pair2: 9->3 shift -6. so shift=-6 always.
    sh=-6
    for y,x in bot[5]: out[y+sh][x]=bot[0]
    for k,o in enumerate(kept):
        oy=o[1]+sh; bx=o[2]+(bot[2]-bot[2])  # align columns to bottom bbox
        ox=o[2]+(bot[2]-o[2])
        for y,x in o[5]: out[y+oy][x+(ox-o[2]+bot[2])]=o[0]
    return out

for i in (1,2,3):
    print(i, solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

        for y,x in k[1]: out[y-6+2][x+(bc-kc) if False else x-bc+kc]=k[0]
